$comment: SPEC §5.4 — the five user-visible confidence states. CLOSED SET. Added in M8 after the two languages had drifted: `sitara_api` served `verified_limited_birth_data`/`tradition_based_general` (which §5.4's own table names) while the M7 component library typed `verified_limited`/`tradition_general`, so the API's own values could not have rendered a chip. Nothing caught it because no screen consumed a confidence state until S13. Python's enum stays hand-written in facts.py (it lives among the Pydantic fact models); this file is its neutral source and `test_parity.py` fails on any divergence in either direction.
